name: Member Savings Statement Portal
description: Members check their savings balance and download statements without visiting the branch.

intake.description: Members keep asking our branches for their savings balance and statements. Many travel to the branch just to ask. We want members to see their savings on their phone and download a statement, and branch staff to print statements quickly for members without phones.

facts.value: Members cannot check their savings without visiting the branch; branches spend hours printing statements.
Self-service balance and statements for members; fewer staff requests; private member data.
Members with a mobile phone; branch staff for printing.
Around 900,000 members in the Dhaka division.
Dhaka division branches first.
Login with one-time code, balance, 12-month transactions, PDF statements, staff printing, SMS alerts.
Loan balances, payments and transfers.
Member portal, staff printing screen, SMS alert service.
May to November 2026.
November 2026.
BDT 95 lakh
Partner Foundation grant
60% fewer statement requests at branches within 3 months of go-live.
Shared phones may expose one-time codes; balances can be 30 minutes old.
Members use 2G/3G phones; the portal must be light.
Staff look up the account in core banking, print and stamp the statement; 10–15 minutes per request.
Members log in with a one-time code and download statements; staff print in one click for members without phones.
No approvals needed; statements are information only.
Monthly logins, downloads and staff prints per branch.
Core banking (every 30 minutes), SMS gateway, branch directory.
BRAC data centre in Dhaka.
One-time codes never logged; 10-minute session timeout; statements not stored.
Pages load within 3 seconds on 3G.
Any phone browser from the last five years.

requirements: Members can check their savings balance and statement without visiting the branch.
Reduce statement requests handled by branch staff by 60%.
Members log in with their mobile number and a one-time code.
Members see their savings balance and the last 12 months of transactions.
Members can download a statement as a PDF.
Branch staff can print a statement for members without phones.
Members get an SMS when a deposit or withdrawal is recorded.
Members trust the statements they see.
Trust cannot be tested directly. Covered by the accuracy tests for BR-02 and the member survey after go-live.
Login with mobile number and a 6-digit one-time code, valid for 5 minutes.
Lock the account for 30 minutes after 5 wrong codes.
The balance screen shows the balance as of the last core banking sync.
The transaction list covers 12 months, newest first, 20 per page.
PDF statements carry BRAC branding and the branch details.
Staff print a member's statement from the branch screen.
An SMS is sent within 5 minutes of a transaction being recorded.
Pages load within 3 seconds on a 3G connection.
